text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was a rest day set for the team. How 
to spend it was up to each person—or so it 
was supposed to be, but strangely, 
everyone ended up gathering together.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Geez, it's my day off and it just had to 
rain...
choice_data_list: Going out feels like such a hassle...

Going out feels like such a hassle, you 
know...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Does everyone have nothing to do and feel 
bored? Well then, wanna play a game?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I've kinda been keeping an eye out and 
checking up on this new release, and its 
name isâ

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Grand Battle Versus"! A sword-fighting 
game where you can customize your own 
character and battle!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Whoa♡ There are cute outfits like this 
too?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready? Alright, let's battle right 
away! O—

text_block_list.name: Game Audio
text_block_list.text: 『Loves Only You WIN!』

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's going on?! What happened?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, with the fighting game demon's 
blood surging in her veins, Loves Only 
You's streak of overwhelming victories 
continued—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Loves Only You WIN‼

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Loves Only You WIN‼ WIN‼ WIN‼ WIN‼

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Guh...! What insane strength...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, my big sis trained me well at games 
like this♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Still, staying like this forever won't be 
any fun...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't mind being suuuper gentle with 
you, you know♡

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah... look who's talking big! I'll wipe 
that smug look right off your face!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Still, in reality, the difference in our 
skill sets is on another level... How on 
earth do we overcome this...?"
choice_data_list: No, we have a shot at winning—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There certainly is a gap in skill. But 
everyone here has "something they know." 
And that is—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, perhaps it's about time to wrap 
things up—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ! It was blocked...!?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Heheh♪ Hearing that just reminded me. What 
it means to "get it".

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"When Loves gets that look in her eye, it 
means she's about to make a move just like 
this!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I see... We've spent all this time 
together as a team, after all... No wonder 
you understand me so well...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu... That is just so—love♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the rainy day fighting game 
tournament grew even more heated—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"‘Shingeki no Battle Rondo’! Teams clash 
against each other to survive! It's a 
competitive survival-action game!"
choice_data_list: So teamwork is what matters, huh!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey. An enemy is coming from that 
side, Marche...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Marche...?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: Ah... um... uuu...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Can't really put it on while holding a 
controller, huh?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Geez, guess there's no helping it...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, move as you like. Just don't 
stray too far. You'll do fine even if left 
alone anyway.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, took their territory! Let's 
keep pressing the attack like this!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, an enemy!? Whoa, that was close... I 
didn't even notice them...!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that was a big help. Thanks, Marche.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, you and I have known each other 
for a decent while now, after all.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wait... There's an in-game chat 
feature!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I see, so even players who can't speak to 
each other directly can coordinate like 
this~

text_block_list.name: In-Game Chat
text_block_list.text:
"Yay☆ Got the bonus carrot♪ Let's seize 
the moment and go on the offensive~!"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Does she perceive the game space itself as 
a kind of "avatar"? Aha☆ How fascinating~

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, that's the one thing about you I 
still can't wrap my head around...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Prism Connect Re:Quest"! An MMORPG set in 
a fantasy world, depicted with 
ultra-gorgeous graphics!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, this is really well made... There 
are a ton of jobs to choose from, too."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Class: Holy Healer, one who mends allies 
with divine power"... Ah, this must surely 
be my calling...!

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, this village is doomed... The army 
of General Blackblood is already 
approaching from beyond the mountains..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, that's terrible...! Please rest 
assured. We will defeat General Blackblood 
without fail, and—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
No, wait, wait, wait. Look at the 
recommended quest level. We're nowhere 
near high enough, right?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Something like that is no reason to turn 
our backs on people crying out for 
salvation...!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Look at their earnest eyes—!! Are you 
saying you can turn a blind eye and just 
walk away, Espo-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... That General Blackblood was 
tough...
choice_data_list: The gap in levels was huge...
The gap in levels was huge, you know...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, the smiles on the faces of the 
villagers— truly, the joy of saving people 
is irreplaceable...♪

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I might actually agree with that.

text_block_list.name: Town Resident
text_block_list.text:
People disappear every full moon...! Ugh, 
that makes 8 people already...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The next full moon is—tonight! 
Everyone...!
choice_data_list:
Wait, the recommended level for this 
quest...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, so what if I did!? It's a hell of a 
lot better than standing by and watching 
villains run amok!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
This presence— Here it comes, an executive 
of the Hellblood Army—...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, works out great, don't it— If we 
finish it off here, light will return to 
that town—!
choice_data_list: There is no reason... to back down!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as we were all playfully messing 
around in good spirits—

text_block_list.name: 『DREAMS』
text_block_list.text: "WOOOOOOOO!! Take thiiiiiis!!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! 'The Dark Blood Dripping from 
the Abyss' has now been vanquished right 
here—!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Old man Knight of Light... I've avenged 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
You accomplished it... The critical task 
to save the world...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The entire team had become completely 
absorbed in the game's world, and it took 
a while for them to snap back to reality.
